034        public static int NUM_TICKS = 11;

046        protected boolean canDamageHull() {
047                if (target != null && target.isFighter()) {
048                        return true;
049                }
050                return false;
051        }
052        
053        public void onHit(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, CombatEntityAPI target, Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit, ApplyDamageResultAPI damageResult, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
054                if (shieldHit) return;
055                if (projectile.isFading()) return;
056                if (!(target instanceof ShipAPI)) return;
057                
058                Vector2f offset = Vector2f.sub(point, target.getLocation(), new Vector2f());
059                offset = Misc.rotateAroundOrigin(offset, -target.getFacing());
060                
061                DisintegratorEffect effect = new DisintegratorEffect(projectile, (ShipAPI) target, offset);
062                CombatEntityAPI e = engine.addLayeredRenderingPlugin(effect);
063                e.getLocation().set(projectile.getLocation());
064        }
065        
066        public static class ParticleData {
067                public SpriteAPI sprite;
068                public Vector2f offset = new Vector2f();
069                public Vector2f vel = new Vector2f();
070                public float scale = 1f;
071                public float scaleIncreaseRate = 1f;
072                public float turnDir = 1f;
073                public float angle = 1f;
074                
075                public float maxDur;
076                public FaderUtil fader;
077                public float elapsed = 0f;
078                public float baseSize;
079                
080                public Color color = new Color(100,150,255,35);
081                
082                public ParticleData(float baseSize, float maxDur, float endSizeMult) {
083                        sprite = Global.getSettings().getSprite("misc", "nebula_particles");
084                        //sprite = Global.getSettings().getSprite("misc", "dust_particles");
085                        float i = Misc.random.nextInt(4);
086                        float j = Misc.random.nextInt(4);
087                        sprite.setTexWidth(0.25f);
088                        sprite.setTexHeight(0.25f);
089                        sprite.setTexX(i * 0.25f);
090                        sprite.setTexY(j * 0.25f);
091                        sprite.setAdditiveBlend();
092                        
093                        angle = (float) Math.random() * 360f;
094                        
095                        this.maxDur = maxDur;
096                        scaleIncreaseRate = endSizeMult / maxDur;
097                        if (endSizeMult < 1f) {
098                                scaleIncreaseRate = -1f * endSizeMult;
099                        }
100                        scale = 1f;
101                        
102                        this.baseSize = baseSize;
103                        turnDir = Math.signum((float) Math.random() - 0.5f) * 20f * (float) Math.random();
104                        //turnDir = 0f;
105                        
106                        float driftDir = (float) Math.random() * 360f;
107                        vel = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(driftDir);
108                        //vel.scale(proj.getProjectileSpec().getLength() / maxDur * (0f + (float) Math.random() * 3f));
109                        vel.scale(0.25f * baseSize / maxDur * (1f + (float) Math.random() * 1f));
110                        
111                        fader = new FaderUtil(0f, 0.5f, 0.5f);
112                        fader.forceOut();
113                        fader.fadeIn();
114                }
115                
116                public void advance(float amount) {
117                        scale += scaleIncreaseRate * amount;
118                        
119                        offset.x += vel.x * amount;
120                        offset.y += vel.y * amount;
121                                
122                        angle += turnDir * amount;
123                        
124                        elapsed += amount;
125                        if (maxDur - elapsed <= fader.getDurationOut() + 0.1f) {
126                                fader.fadeOut();
127                        }
128                        fader.advance(amount);
129                }
130        }

160        public void init(CombatEntityAPI entity) {
161                super.init(entity);
162        }
163        
164        public void advance(float amount) {
165                if (Global.getCombatEngine().isPaused()) return;
166                
167                Vector2f loc = new Vector2f(offset);
168                loc = Misc.rotateAroundOrigin(loc, target.getFacing());
169                Vector2f.add(target.getLocation(), loc, loc);
170                entity.getLocation().set(loc);
171                
172                List<ParticleData> remove = new ArrayList<ParticleData>();
173                for (ParticleData p : particles) {
174                        p.advance(amount);
175                        if (p.elapsed >= p.maxDur) {
176                                remove.add(p);
177                        }
178                }
179                particles.removeAll(remove);
180                
181                float volume = 1f;
182                if (ticks >= getNumTicks() || !target.isAlive() || !Global.getCombatEngine().isEntityInPlay(target)) {
183                        fader.fadeOut();
184                        fader.advance(amount);
185                        volume = fader.getBrightness();
186                }
187                Global.getSoundPlayer().playLoop(getSoundLoopId(), target, 1f, volume, loc, target.getVelocity());
188                
189                
190                interval.advance(amount);
191                if (interval.intervalElapsed() && ticks < getNumTicks()) {
192                        dealDamage();
193                        ticks++;
194                }
195        }

205        protected void addParticle() {
206                ParticleData p = new ParticleData(30f, 3f + (float) Math.random() * 2f, 2f);
207                particles.add(p);
208                p.offset = Misc.getPointWithinRadius(p.offset, 20f);
209        }

211        protected void damageDealt(Vector2f loc, float hullDamage, float armorDamage) {
212                
213        }
214        
215        protected void dealDamage() {
216                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
217                
218                int num = getNumParticlesPerTick();
219                for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
220                        addParticle();
221                }
222                
223                
224                Vector2f point = new Vector2f(entity.getLocation());
225                
226                // maximum armor in a cell is 1/15th of the ship's stated armor rating
227
228                ArmorGridAPI grid = target.getArmorGrid();
229                int[] cell = grid.getCellAtLocation(point);
230                if (cell == null) return;
231                
232                int gridWidth = grid.getGrid().length;
233                int gridHeight = grid.getGrid()[0].length;
234                
235                float damageTypeMult = getDamageTypeMult(proj.getSource(), target);
236                
237                float damagePerTick = (float) getTotalDamage() / (float) getNumTicks();
238                float damageDealt = 0f;
239                float hullDamage = 0f;
240                for (int i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
241                        for (int j = -2; j <= 2; j++) {
242                                if ((i == 2 || i == -2) && (j == 2 || j == -2)) continue; // skip corners
243                                
244                                int cx = cell[0] + i;
245                                int cy = cell[1] + j;
246                                
247                                if (cx < 0 || cx >= gridWidth || cy < 0 || cy >= gridHeight) continue;
248                                
249                                float damMult = 1/30f;
250                                if (i == 0 && j == 0) {
251                                        damMult = 1/15f;
252                                } else if (i <= 1 && i >= -1 && j <= 1 && j >= -1) { // S hits
253                                        damMult = 1/15f;
254                                } else { // T hits
255                                        damMult = 1/30f;
256                                }
257                                
258                                float armorInCell = grid.getArmorValue(cx, cy);
259                                float damage = damagePerTick * damMult * damageTypeMult;
260                                if (damage > armorInCell && canDamageHull()) {
261                                        hullDamage += damage - armorInCell;
262                                }
263                                damage = Math.min(damage, armorInCell);
264                                if (damage <= 0) continue;
265                                
266                                target.getArmorGrid().setArmorValue(cx, cy, Math.max(0, armorInCell - damage));
267                                damageDealt += damage;
268                        }
269                }
270                
271                if (damageDealt > 0) {
272                        if (Misc.shouldShowDamageFloaty(proj.getSource(), target)) {
273                                engine.addFloatingDamageText(point, damageDealt, 0f, Misc.FLOATY_ARMOR_DAMAGE_COLOR, target, proj.getSource());
274                        }
275                        target.syncWithArmorGridState();
276                }
277                
278                if (hullDamage >= 1f) {
279                        float showHullDamage = Math.min(hullDamage, target.getHitpoints());
280                        if (showHullDamage >= 0) {
281                                target.setHitpoints(target.getHitpoints() - hullDamage);
282                                if (target.getHitpoints() <= 0f && !target.isHulk()) {
283                                        target.setSpawnDebris(false);
284                                        engine.applyDamage(target, point, 100f, DamageType.ENERGY, 0f, true, false, proj.getSource(), false);
285                                }
286                                if (Misc.shouldShowDamageFloaty(proj.getSource(), target)) {
287                                        Vector2f p2 = new Vector2f(point);
288                                        p2.y += 20f;
289                                        engine.addFloatingDamageText(p2, hullDamage, 0f, Misc.FLOATY_HULL_DAMAGE_COLOR, target, proj.getSource());
290                                }
291//                              String key = "wfewfewf";
292//                              Float total = (Float) engine.getCustomData().get(key);
293//                              if (total == null) total = 0f;
294//                              total += hullDamage;
295//                              engine.getCustomData().put(key, total);
296//                              System.out.println("Total hull damage dealt: " + total);
297                        }
298                }
299                
300                damageDealt(point, hullDamage, damageDealt);
301                
302        }

304        public boolean isExpired() {
305                return particles.isEmpty() && 
306                                        (ticks >= getNumTicks() || !target.isAlive() || !Global.getCombatEngine().isEntityInPlay(target));
307        }

309        public void render(CombatEngineLayers layer, ViewportAPI viewport) {
310                float x = entity.getLocation().x;
311                float y = entity.getLocation().y;
312                
313                //Color color = new Color(100,150,255,35);
314                float b = viewport.getAlphaMult();
315
316                GL14.glBlendEquation(GL14.GL_FUNC_REVERSE_SUBTRACT);
317                
318                for (ParticleData p : particles) {
319                        //float size = proj.getProjectileSpec().getWidth() * 0.6f;
320                        float size = p.baseSize * p.scale;
321                        
322                        Vector2f loc = new Vector2f(x + p.offset.x, y + p.offset.y);
323                        
324                        float alphaMult = 1f;
325                        
326                        p.sprite.setAngle(p.angle);
327                        p.sprite.setSize(size, size);
328                        p.sprite.setAlphaMult(b * alphaMult * p.fader.getBrightness());
329                        p.sprite.setColor(p.color);
330                        p.sprite.renderAtCenter(loc.x, loc.y);
331                }
332                
333                GL14.glBlendEquation(GL14.GL_FUNC_ADD);
334        }

336        
337        public static float getDamageTypeMult(ShipAPI source, ShipAPI target) {
338                if (source == null || target == null) return 1f;
339                
340                float damageTypeMult = target.getMutableStats().getArmorDamageTakenMult().getModifiedValue();
341                switch (target.getHullSize()) {
342                case CAPITAL_SHIP:
343                        damageTypeMult *= source.getMutableStats().getDamageToCapital().getModifiedValue();
344                        break;
345                case CRUISER:
346                        damageTypeMult *= source.getMutableStats().getDamageToCruisers().getModifiedValue();
347                        break;
348                case DESTROYER:
349                        damageTypeMult *= source.getMutableStats().getDamageToDestroyers().getModifiedValue();
350                        break;
351                case FRIGATE:
352                        damageTypeMult *= source.getMutableStats().getDamageToFrigates().getModifiedValue();
353                        break;
354                case FIGHTER:
355                        damageTypeMult *= source.getMutableStats().getDamageToFighters().getModifiedValue();
356                        break;
357                }
358                return damageTypeMult;
359        }
